content:
The BUILT CoLAB collaborated with EPOS on the development of an immersive training platform based on interactive 360º videos, designed to bring technical training closer to the real conditions found in underground environments.

Available for Virtual Reality devices, such as the Meta Quest 3, and for Android, the solution was developed from content captured in a real mining operation context by the BUILT CoLAB team. The platform allows trainees to follow operational procedures more closely, in an engaging and contextualised way, contributing to the digitalisation and modernisation of internal training processes.

The experience integrates different content formats, including 360º video, 2D video, images, contextual information and formative questions synchronised with the procedures presented. In this way, users can interact with the content throughout the training, benefiting from integrated assessment mechanisms and more dynamic learning.

Among the features developed, particular note goes to the ability to switch between multiple synchronised viewpoints of the same operation, allowing a more complete reading of the procedures carried out and a deeper understanding of the tasks under analysis.

This collaboration also made it possible to validate the potential of immersive technologies for the underground works sector, demonstrating the applicability of Virtual Reality and 360º video solutions in technical training and the transfer of operational knowledge.

With this initiative, BUILT CoLAB and EPOS reinforce the role of immersive technologies as tools to support professional training, bringing training closer to the reality on the ground and contributing to more effective learning.
